props.title: Rezi Cowork MCP — your resume, ==in the room where the work happens.==
props.subtitle: Rezi resume workflows, native to your AI cowork sessions.

slides.notes: Hook: the resume tool and the AI session where you actually work are usually two different rooms. This project makes them one.

props.title: Job applications are ==assembled across tabs.==
props.body: The job post in one, the resume builder in another, the AI assistant in a third — and the context that makes a tailored application good gets lost in the copy-paste between them.

slides.notes: Walk the three-tab story: job post, resume builder, AI assistant. The friction isn't any one tool — it's the handoffs between them.

items.title: Create
items.body: Start a new resume from scratch, right inside the cowork session.

items.title: Tailor
items.body: Adapt your master resume to the exact posting being analyzed.

items.title: Review
items.body: Run Rezi's resume checks without ever leaving the chat.

slides.notes: An MCP server that exposes Rezi to AI agents and cowork tools — create, tailor, and review all happen where the role analysis happens.

props.title: Posting to tailored resume, ==in one session.==

items.title: Connect
items.body: The agent connects to Rezi over MCP.

items.title: Tailor
items.body: It drafts a copy tuned to the posting.

items.title: Review
items.body: It checks the result back — you approve before anything is submitted.

slides.notes: Emphasize the last step: the agent never submits on its own. The human reviews and approves — always.

left.label: Without
left.title: Per-app integrations
points: A custom build for every assistant app

right.label: With
right.title: The MCP protocol
points: Any MCP-capable assistant can drive the workflow
The resume stays in Rezi where it belongs
Works with the tools you already use

slides.notes: MCP is the tool protocol point: build once against the standard, and every MCP-capable assistant can use it. Data stays in Rezi.

tiles.title: Full workflow access
tiles.body: Create, tailor, and review resumes through simple tool calls.

tiles.title: One source of truth
tiles.body: The agent reads your canonical Rezi resume — never a stale export.

tiles.title: Human in the loop
tiles.body: Drafts come back for review. Nothing is submitted without your approval.

tiles.title: Any MCP client
tiles.body: Cowork tools, IDEs, and assistants that speak MCP.

tiles.title: Session-native
tiles.body: Role analysis and resume editing share one context window.

slides.notes: Pick two tiles to speak to — full workflow access and human-in-the-loop are the differentiators. Let the rest be read.

props.title: ==Working server. Open source.==
props.body: The server runs today and the code is public — clone it, run it, and connect your first cowork session.

slides.notes: Not a concept: a working server you can run today, open source on GitHub. Land this quietly and let it sit.
